brief.t: START HERE: Call Polo 4PL and confirm whether TR#47618 / EMCU8614105 was physically picked up before the free-time extension ends October 12.

ACT NOW 1: Polo container TR#47618 / EMCU8614105 had an October 9 pickup appointment, but physical pickup and release remain unconfirmed. Polo and dispatch are waiting on closure. The appointment was 2 calendar days ago, and the free-time extension ends tomorrow, October 12. Send: Vic, please confirm whether TR#47618 / EMCU8614105 was physically picked up on the October 9 appointment; if not, what is today's recovery plan, and is storage waived through October 12?

ACT NOW 2: TALOVA reported a lip balm stockout and requested 500 more units; delivery of the earlier 15,000 units remains unverified. Marcello is waiting. The request is about 2 calendar days old with no stated deadline. Send: Marcello, we are checking availability and a ship date for the additional 500 and verifying delivery of the 15,000, 5,000 per scent; I will confirm both today.

ACT NOW 3: Solabia needs confirmation of PLL's Farmington Hills bill-to address before the 6 kg Estogel Max PO can move cleanly. PO acceptance, a firm ship date, and the remaining 14 kg path are unverified. Solabia is waiting, and no missed supplier commitment is confirmed. Send: Joella and Darren, please update billing to our Farmington Hills address, confirm receipt of PO-2026-0026 for 6 kg, and provide the earliest ship date and lead time for the balance.

next: Recommendation: Close the Polo pickup first because the free-time extension ends tomorrow, then resolve TALOVA and Estogel before Monday production planning.
Scheduled: 5 email-derived milestones. The nearest is the Polo free-time extension ending October 12; shipment 384100536855 is also expected October 12 based on the latest available carrier notice.

Source gaps: CRM and WhatsApp browser sessions are signed out. Purchasing has no current source records to verify open supplier, QC, inventory, or lead-time risks. The Email lane reports the Sam-owned Proteger agreement response is 7 calendar days overdue. Missing data is not zero.
signal: Polo pickup remains unconfirmed one day before free time ends. TALOVA's stockout and 500-unit replenishment remain unresolved. Solabia still needs the billing update and a firm Estogel Max ship date.
redflags: Polo physical pickup is unverified and free time ends October 12.
TALOVA's requested 500-unit replenishment and proof of delivery for the prior 15,000 units remain unverified.
The Estogel Max 6 kg PO lacks confirmed acceptance and a firm ship date; the remaining 14 kg path is unverified.
CRM and WhatsApp could not be scanned because both browser sessions are signed out.
noise: 7 inbound Outlook messages arrived in 7 unique conversations during the exact review window; 5 were unread and 6 were noise.
